paragraphs: INFODEV EDI develops and installs automatic passenger and people counting systems and has worked in this industry since 1993. The counting systems cover buses, trains, trams, subways, and railway and bus stations. Infodev EDI describes years of experience implementing automatic passenger counting projects in public transit. The home page describes ridership data for transit agencies that goes beyond basic passenger counts.

The DA-Series counting sensors are stated as accurate between 97.5% and 99.5%, at door level and without a correction factor. The DA-400 is a directional sensor that can be as thin as 13.5 mm for surface or inside-panel mounting above doors. The DA-200 is built to fit narrow doors and holds a single sensor in an aluminium case.

The GW-400 is a compact onboard counting computer that works with the DA-Series sensors to form an automatic passenger counting system. Data is usually transferred directly from the GW-400 via a wireless module to the ground data analysis server. INFODEV EDI also offers a software package alongside the counting hardware. Systems come in two architectures, a classical one that yields historical data for analysis and reporting and an enhanced one that yields real-time data.
